name: Gakkou no Kowai Uwasa Hanako-san ga Kita!! Minna no Hanako-san
original_name: 学校のコワイうわさ 花子さんがきた!! みんなの花子さん
source:
There are lots of horror stories, but "Hanako-san" is one of the most popular ones. Is it just a rumor?
When wet footsteps are heard or there is silence during telephone call, it may as well be Hanako-san. But she also helps children who are in dangerous situations. She has youkai rivals called Yamiko-san and Yomi-san, so her life is never boring.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
恐怖故事数不胜数，而「花子同学」是其中最脍炙人口的一个。她真的只是传闻吗？
听见湿漉漉的脚步声，或电话中突然一片沉寂时，说不定就是花子同学来了。不过，她也会帮助身陷险境的孩子。她还有名叫暗子和黄泉子的妖怪对手，生活从不无聊。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
